svg.title: API DESIGN: sketchnote
svg.text: Spend five minutes, get the important details right, and move on to the design.
GET /feed?cursor=(ts,id)&limit=20: stable when new items arrive
Idempotency-Key header + unique index → retries are safe
user_id comes from the JWT; never trust {user_id} in the request
/v1/… or header; add optional fields only
"REST with resources from our entities: POST /bookings with an idempotency key, cursor-paginated
GET /bookings. User identity comes from the auth token."
Spending 15 minutes on endpoint shapes is a classic way to run out of time for the deep dives.
Name resources after your core entities.
Take the user's identity from the auth
Return 202 and a job ID for long work.
take an idempotency key, lists use cursor
pagination, and identity comes from the token."
